summary.text: Tarik Khan is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives for District 194, which he has represented since December 2022, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. His career experience includes working as a family nurse practitioner.

paragraphs.text: Khan graduated from Central High School of Philadelphia in 1996.
He earned a B.A. from Davidson College in 2000, an M.S. in nursing from La Salle University in 2011, and a Ph.D. from the University of Pennsylvania in 2022.
Khan assumed office in the House on December 1, 2022, succeeding Pamela DeLissio.
